svg.title: Star map of the Drift
svg.desc: A schematic star chart of the Drift's 26 systems, lettered A through Z, scattered irregularly rather than gridded, each drawn as a stylized star colored and sized by spectral type. Exotic systems such as a pulsar, a black hole remnant, a binary pair, and a white dwarf are marked distinctly. Kerath sits roughly central at K.
svg.text: Color = temperature: B/A hot (blue-white) through M cool (red, most common).
Rings and extras flag exotic systems: pulsar, black hole, binary, dwarf, giant.
